name: YMCA of Southern Maine Summer and School Break Camps (Camp Heartwood & Camp Osprey)
description_short: YMCA day camps for ages 5–12, running Monday–Friday 9:30am–3:30pm at two sites: Camp Heartwood in Biddeford, a nature program on 26 acres, and Camp Osprey in Freeport, a traditional camp with one-week sessions. Before and after care are included at no extra charge, and there are also February and April school break camps for ages 5–10.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp Heartwood: swimming 3x per week. Camp Osprey lists swimming among activities. Pool/waterfront details not stated.

warnings: The page shows only the 2026 season (break camps in Feb/Apr 2026, summer June 15–Aug 21), and all of those dates have passed as of 2026-10-13. 2027 dates are not posted yet.

The page covers two camp sites, so address and contact details differ by site. Camp Heartwood: 3 Pomerleau St., Biddeford, ME 04005, 207-283-0100, bhamilton@ymcaofsouthernmaine.org (Brenda Hamilton). Camp Osprey: 14 Old South Freeport Rd, Freeport, ME 04032, 207-865-9600, hsmith@ymcaofsouthernmaine.org (Haley Smith).
Summer is recorded as one block. Camp Osprey says it offers one-week sessions, but the page does not list individual weeks or say whether Heartwood books by the week.
The page does not say whether the break camps run at Heartwood, Osprey, or both.
The page gives registration open dates without a year. 2026 was inferred from the season shown.
